episodes.synopsis: A regular kid named Johnny Bolt suddenly finds that he can control electricity. Soon enough, he starts testing the limits of his newfound powers.
episodes.title: Electro Boy

episodes.synopsis: As soon as he's released from prison, Johnny meets up with his old supervillain friends, who try to pull him into a very intriguing gem heist.
episodes.title: Kasey

episodes.synopsis: Things don't go as planned with the heist, and Johnny and the crew end up getting chased by cops and superheroes through the streets of San Francisco.
episodes.title: Man Mountain

episodes.synopsis: Johnny and his friends are confronted by Praetorian, a superhero who relishes using his seemingly endless abilities to punish them.
episodes.title: The Praetorian

episodes.synopsis: In Chicago, Carmine introduces Johnny and Kasey to the other supervillains. They've all been chosen for their specific powers and their nameless status.
episodes.title: The Heat

episodes.synopsis: Carmine and his crew steal a plane and fly off to rescue TK, who's on a heavily guarded aircraft protected by Gladiator.
episodes.title: The Gladiator

episodes.synopsis: While waiting for the final member of their crew to show up, Carmine shares his plan with everyone else and gives them one last chance to drop out.
episodes.title: The Supermax

episodes.synopsis: The night before hitting the Union of Justice headquarters, Johnny and Kasey have an early celebration and vow to walk away from crime after this heist.
episodes.title: The Union of Justice

episodes.synopsis: While confronting their old friend Praetorian, Carmine and the crew realize they've made a major miscalculation and have to think on their feet.
episodes.title: Count Orlok

episodes.synopsis: Johnny's old supervillain buddies take him out for a celebration and as usual, try to pull him into one last harebrained job.
episodes.title: Carmine

episodes.synopsis: To save Carmine, Johnny tries to get the crew back together for another heist he's planned using information he gathered while serving time in supermax.
episodes.title: Casino Grand Granite

episodes.synopsis: Kasey and Roddy disguise themselves as professors for a meeting with Christopher Matts while Carmine, Johnny, TK and Josh case the casino.
episodes.title: The Bastard

episodes.synopsis: Christopher Matts sends Praetorian to stop Johnny and his crew — but this time, the supervillains have Gladiator on their side.
episodes.title: SUPER CROOKS
